entities.summary: Govanni Battista Seni, also known as Giovanni Battista Seno or Johann Baptist Zeno or Zenno or Senno, was a 17th-century Italian astrologer, who acted as the personal astrologer and advisor to Albrecht von Wallenstein, Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial armed forces during the Thirty Years' War.
